stem: A hiking club has 180 members. Of these members, 96 own a tent, 70 own a kayak, and 34 own neither a tent nor a kayak. If a member who owns a tent is selected at random, what is the probability that the member also owns a kayak?
solution: Members who own a tent or a kayak (or both): \(180 - 34 = 146\).
Of the 96 tent owners, 20 own a kayak, so the probability is \(\frac{20}{96} = \frac{5}{24}\).
verify:
both = 96 + 70 - (180 - 34)
assert both == 20
p = Rational(both, 96)
assert p == Rational(5, 24)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [p]
